description: Julia package for solving PDEs with finite volume methods: a cell-vertex parabolic/elliptic solver on unstructured triangular meshes, a cell-centered hyperbolic solver on structured meshes (Euler, MHD, GRMHD, AMR), and an experimental OpenFOAM-style collocated incompressible solver stack. Research-grade v3 development fork of DanielVandH/FiniteVolumeMethod.jl.
title: FiniteVolumeMethod.jl
